user_reported_bug: Cart + Checkout Mobile Audit: Run the same 320/375/390 strict-fit test against /cart and /checkout so the whole buy flow is bullet-proof on phones
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused live-preview verification logged in as the buyer, added a real listing to cart, then measured /cart and /checkout/<listing_id> at 320x568, 375x812, and 390x844. The documentElement/body scrollWidth checks pass on both pages, and checkout inputs/sticky Pay bar fit; however /cart key buy-flow elements are visibly wider than the viewport at all three widths, so the audit is not fixed.

ui_bugs.component: Cart mobile product rows and totals card
ui_bugs.issue: At 320, 375, and 390px widths, cart rows and the order summary render about 419.3px wide from left=16 to right=435.3, beyond the viewport. The checkout button inside the summary renders about 377.3px wide from left=37 to right=414.3. On 320px, a seller-link chip also extends right=330.78. document/body scrollWidth is masked by overflow-x:hidden, but the visible cart content is clipped/not strict-fit.

issues: 320x568: html/body scrollWidth=320 pass, but cart rows/order-summary right edge=435.3 > 321 tolerance.
375x812: html/body scrollWidth=375 pass, but cart rows/order-summary right edge=435.3 > 376 tolerance.
390x844: html/body scrollWidth=390 pass, but cart rows/order-summary right edge=435.3 > 391 tolerance.

action_items: Fix Cart.jsx mobile layout so the cart grid, product row cards, order summary, checkout button, and seller links are max-w-full/min-w-0 and wrap/stack within 320px without relying on global overflow-x:hidden.
Retest /cart and /checkout/<listing_id> at 320x568, 375x812, and 390x844 with both scrollWidth and key-element bounding-rect checks.
critical_code_review_comments: Cart.jsx still uses a mobile grid/flex structure without min-w-0/max-w-full containment on the grid children and row cards; the fixed image plus metadata/price columns produce a min-content width around 419px.
App.js/index.css overflow-x:hidden makes documentElement/body scrollWidth pass, but it does not satisfy the user-visible requirement that cart rows and totals fit instead of being clipped.

success_rate.frontend: 50% route/viewport combinations fully passed (checkout 3/3, cart 0/3); scrollWidth-only subcheck passed 6/6

seed_data_creation: Logged in with the provided buyer credentials and added live listing bcf67cba-59f6-46e4-84ef-1f31ecfed288 to the buyer cart via POST /api/cart/{listing_id} for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Skill lookup returned no relevant testing skill. Use /app/tests/bug_cart_checkout_mobile_fit_iteration25.py against the live preview. Expected fixed behavior: /cart and /checkout at 320/375/390 should have html/body scrollWidth <= innerWidth+1 AND key cart/checkout elements' bounding rects within viewport. This run found checkout passed, but cart rows/order-summary remained 419.3px wide and clipped at all widths.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: set mobile viewport, skip splash, login as sophia_style@demo.local, add listing bcf67cba-59f6-46e4-84ef-1f31ecfed288 to cart, visit /cart and /checkout/bcf67cba-59f6-46e4-84ef-1f31ecfed288. Root/body scrollWidth equals innerWidth because overflow-x is hidden globally, but cart grid children keep a min-content width (~419px). The result is no horizontal scrollbar but clipped product rows/totals, so the user-visible mobile buy flow is still not bullet-proof.
